text: As the Patriots prepare for Jacksonville, rookie linebacker Gabe Jacas figures to remain a centerpiece of the defensive scheme after making impact plays in the first two weeks and earning a start in Week 3, though the secondary will look markedly different with cornerback Carlton Davis III returning while safeties Craig Woodson (shoulder) and Mike Brown await clarity on their statuses—the latter elevated from the practice squad alongside defensive tackle Jeremiah Pharms Jr. The injury situation has proven particularly complicated on the edge, where the Patriots ruled out both Dre'Mont Jones and Quintayvious Hutchins, the latter subsequently placed on injured reserve with a knee injury, making depth a genuine concern against a Jaguars offense looking to bounce back from what they themselves characterize as their worst performance in nearly a year. Meanwhile, tight end Eli Raridon's return to practice this week represents an encouraging sign as the Patriots continue monitoring his thigh, and the coaching staff has taken to heart the need for better clock management after two consecutive games marred by questionable late-half decisions before the break.
